worldcombat.skill.aircutter.summary: Spread a single sheet of thin wind blades that sweeps the sector in front and cuts several foes at once; short wind-up, low cooldown, high critical chance. Focus form is narrower and heavier; wide-fan form is wider and denser.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.use.0: Sweep a whole arc of foes in front in one spread
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.use.1: Cut several targets bunched inside the fan at once
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.use.2: Instant and cheap, forcing foes to move during the short wind-up
Each thin blade deals %1$s special damage.
The fan reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s-degree span.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.focus.on: Focus form: each blade is heavier (power ×1.22) and range is +1 block, but the span shrinks to 0.62x and cooldown is 5 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.focus.off: Wide-fan form (default): the fan spans its full width, but each blade is lighter (power ×0.94).
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s and the fan radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.preference.f: On: every wind blade is heavier (power ×1.22) and the fan radius is +1 block, but the span shrinks to 0.62x and cooldown is 5 ticks longer — for cutting one point precisely. Off (wide-fan form, default): the fan spans its full width, but each blade is lighter (×0.94) — for sweeping foes bunched together.
worldcombat.skill.aircutter.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values open the fan from farther away, where a foe can still walk out of the wind-up.
On: when two or more foes sit inside the fan direction, the spread is preferred and cuts them together. Off: the head count is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary short-range cut.
